name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Sour Blue Razz Lemonade
description: Enjoy sweet n’ sour with Double-Stacked Sour Blue Razz Lemonade BITEZ. Two bold layers pair electric, tart blue raspberry with a sharp, citrusy lemonade kick for a neon-bright sweet-and-sour flavor that brings serious pucker. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A heavy-hitting sour combo made for those who like their flavor loud.
